scope: strict historical zero-step status and pinned external Actions policy on existing GET-only stacked PR preflight

staticAssessment.scope: read-only pre-PR exact source and account metadata (no billing attestation)

newCases: selected Actions policy requires separate source review
local_only Actions policy rejects external marketplace actions
unfinished historical job cannot prove completed failure
boolean stepCount false cannot be accepted as integer zero
other source failure retains honest separate historical zero-step evidence

limits: Repository-wide allowed_actions=all is a necessary frozen policy condition, but not proof that GitHub account billing can admit a new hosted runner.
Historical zero-step metadata remains recorded only for R7, not a claim about a future attempt.
Passing this read-only source gate cannot authorize creation of a PR, a workflow attempt, protected main merge, actual Windows/IPC acceptance or DEV activation.
A selected/local-only repository policy requires independent permission review instead of being treated as identical to unrestricted Actions.
Unreviewed changes to PR/candidate refs or any newer workflow evidence must trigger re-review.
